label: Bold
purpose: Bold type and statement: one sentence per slide at display size on flat blueprint blue, ink, white and paper grounds that change from role to role as the swipe device. For a day with one strong claim, a regulation or an attributed quote, and few or no pictures.

background.source: --surface-reading in DESIGN_SYSTEM.md; the white ground of the figure slide and the type on blue and ink grounds.

surface.source: --surface-page in DESIGN_SYSTEM.md; the paper ground of the sources slide and the note under a statement.

surface-strong.source: --surface-subtle in DESIGN_SYSTEM.md; labels and credits on the blue and ink grounds.

foreground.source: --text-primary in DESIGN_SYSTEM.md; type on white and paper, and the ink ground of split, single photo and the INK statement.

muted.source: --text-secondary in DESIGN_SYSTEM.md; body copy, credits and the picture hairline on white and paper.

accent.source: Blueprint blue: --accent-primary and the DNESK colour of the logotype; the ground of the cover, the statement and the type-only announcement.

secondary.source: The Ai colour of the logotype (brandAi in lib/og-theme.ts); the kicker on white and paper.

headline.source: A condensed grotesque at 700, set in sentence case: it carries a sentence at display size inside the 936 px measure, and its Czech accents are drawn glyphs with the same 0.70 em cap height as Space Grotesk.

body.source: A plain sans for the short note under each statement, so the display face stays the only loud thing on the slide.

mono.source: BRAND_SYSTEM.md: dates, issue identifiers, source ids, tags, captions and measured values.
